title: [Sutana's Designs, Flooring]
description: Broad sample platforms cover the floor in neat sections, each fitted with a different pattern of planks, boards, or inlaid wood.  Smooth paths guide visitors between displays, allowing grain, finish, and joinery to be seen up close and underfoot.  Lantern light reflects softly from polished surfaces while rougher samples show tool marks and natural flaws, offering a clear sense of texture, tone, and craftsmanship.
